story.title: Operation Blue Cicada
story.subtitle: A radio serial’s lost final episode contains orders for a sleeper agent.
story.premise: radio producer Armand Célier's private listening party for the final episode of The Blue Cicada brings five accomplished strangers to a house in Grambois. Each accepted a different private promise from Armand Célier; one came to make sure that promise could never be kept.
story.hostRole: Armand Célier, radio producer and former resistance broadcaster; then Game Master

characters.publicFace: Warm, theatrical, and allergic to silence

characters.invitationPromise: Armand promised you the lead in his international adaptation.
characters.privateIdentity: You improvised a line years ago that became an intelligence recognition phrase.
characters.privateObjective: Protect your career while learning who weaponized your voice.
characters.privateSecret: You kept the original rehearsal pages after claiming they were burned.

story.solution: Hugo was the dormant agent. He understood the rehearsal line, silenced Armand during the listening break, and blamed the missing ending on professional sabotage. The guests’ independent memories show the script was a trap and that Hugo reacted to details no innocent actor had heard.

clues.text: The script’s scene numbers form a shortwave frequency.
Only Hugo received the unrevised rehearsal line containing the word CICADA.
Armand’s private promises were designed to make every guest listen for a different layer of the episode.
The cottage was used for an earlier clandestine recording, not for the killing.
Hugo knew the final line had been cut before the producer announced it.
